_about: Acetonitrile (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetonitrile, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Zhu, J.[Jiujuan], Li, Q.[Qunsheng], Li, M.[Manman], Song, X.[Xiaoling], Tang, H.[Hongjian], Liu, Y.[Yudong], The isobaric vapor liquid equilibria of ethyl acetate p acetonitrile p bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide-based ionic liquids at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 425 (2016) 289-296
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0069. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.16 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
